eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Honolulu, HI; at 7:00 PM on AUG 23, 2018 Effective until 11:00 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A HURRICANE WARNING IS IN EFFECT.  EXTREMELY DANGEROUS WIND AND FLOODING MAY OCCUR TONIGHT.  FLOODING MAY OCCUR IN COASTAL AREAS, NEAR STREAMS AND LOW LYING AREAS.  IF YOUR HOME IS THREATENED, LEAVE THE AREA.  THE BUS WILL TRANSPORT PEOPLE TO SHELTER AND NO FARE IS REQUIRED.  BEACHES AND BEACH PARKS ARE CLOSED.
